CustomField.description: Optional one-word label chosen from the tag chips (Observation, Question, Unexpected, Follow-up by default). Deliberately TEXT, not a picklist: the available tags come from UAT_Focus_Prompt__mdt and a cycle can override them via Test_Cycle__c.Focus_Prompts__c, so the value set is config and must not be pinned in schema. Blank is valid — tagging is entirely optional.
CustomField.label: Tag
